title: Corporate Governance Beyond the Human
description: How do we bring a sense of kinship with the more-than-human world into the boardroom, where power is shared, decisions are made and value is distributed? A dialogue with Leena Al Olaimy, co-founder of Diversity on Board, in the 19th session of the Co-creation with the More-than-Human sandbox, hosted by Renilde Becqué and Justine Huxley. Monday 14 December 2026, 8am Pacific (4pm GMT), one hour; Online; Free to join; the hosts welcome tips. Offered by The Repatterning Collective and Kincentric Leadership. Listed in the Relational River's Springs; join through the makers' own page.
